title: Green Dog and Lobsters
description: A vibrant green dog stands in the foreground looking up at a large circular cosmic mandala filled with exploding pink lobsters, black insects, and green leaves. Below, a massive crowd of people fills an arena, all gazing upward with many raising their hands.
prompt: A large vibrant lime green dog stands in profile looking up toward a massive glowing circular mandala in the sky. The mandala explodes with bright pink lobsters, black insects, and green leaves in a radial pattern. In the foreground the dog is covered with pink lobsters. Below is a huge crowd of people in an arena looking up with hands raised, dramatic lighting, surreal pop art style.
